liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider got the whole stands going [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-07-10.135276.mtx.tobin.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 33 songs; 209 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-07-10.149955.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 33 songs; 211 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: The file set is 16-bit at 44.1 kHz [2]
- **gd1987-07-10.aud.carpenter.87266.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 33 songs; 203 min [7]. Said about its sound: Levels rise gradually in Iko Iko; mic bumps occur throughout [7]
- **gd87-07-10.senn.lai.3859.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 31 songs; 200 min; rated 3.91/5 by 32 [8]. Said about its sound: Recording sound is hard to listen to, unlike top-notch archive recordings [20]

## Around the show

- Bob Dylan joined for the second set, playing acoustic guitar [1]
- A complete train wreck false start occurred with Dylan [15]
- Stadium packed with about 110,000 people; bikers hooted at a long phattie [16]
- Dylan almost retired before rehearsals; the band helped rejuvenate his energy [17]
- Reviewer and date appeared on the big screen projections during the wait [18]
- It was so hot on the floor that people were passing out [20]
- Driving home, the group slammed into a toll gate behind friends [21]
- Temperature on the field was around 105 to 110 degrees; reviewer wore jeans [24]
- Performance lacked the 'uuumph' of the Roanoke show from a couple weeks prior [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-07-10.135276.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=101651) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> FLAC; All… [1]
- **gd1987-07-10.149955.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 6, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]. Also: Don Pearson and Dan Healy recorded the show using multiple masters [2]
- **gd1987-07-10.aud.carpenter.87266.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM-700's > patched from one Sony D5 > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's (no Dolby), set up FOB [7]. Also: Soundforge used for fades, levels, and patches; TLH for SBE-OK [7]
- **gd87-07-10.senn.lai.3859.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB> aud> senn me80> cassette master> cdr [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-07-10 John F Kennedy Stadium, Philadelphia, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-07-10-john-f-kennedy-stadium-philadelphia-pa-usa/) [28]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead JFK Stadium 7/10/87](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/jfk-stadium-7-10-87) [29]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead John F. Kennedy Stadium - July 10, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-10-1987) [30]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1987-07-10 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1987-07-10-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [31]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead John F. Kennedy Stadium - July 10, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-10-1987) [32]
- Poster by www.obatik.com: [Bob Dylan with The Grateful Dead – Men Of Peace – Jerry Scott](https://www.obatik.com/album/collections/songs/music-log/august-2011-albums/bob-dylan-with-the-grateful-dead-men-of-peace/) [33]
